Hotels located near Hoi An Ancient Town are always among the top choices for travelers, as staying close to the old quarter helps save travel time and makes sightseeing much more convenient. Understanding this, Vietlook Travel is pleased to introduce five high-quality, great-value hotels that are truly worth experiencing during your trip to Hoi An. Let’s take a closer look.

In Depth Review Of The Top 5 Best Value Hotels In Hoi An

A memorable trip starts with finding the right place to stay comfortable, well-located, and suitable for your budget. Below are five highly rated hotels that many travelers recommend for an autumn getaway in Hoi An.

1. Anantara Hoi An Resort

Located along the poetic Thu Bon River, Anantara Hoi An Resort is one of the most prestigious five-star hotels near Hoi An Ancient Town. Like other properties in the Anantara collection, the resort beautifully incorporates local charm into its design. Anantara Hoi An is a harmonious blend of French colonial architecture with influences from Dutch, Chinese, and Japanese cultures.

Guests can enjoy complimentary services such as morning yoga classes, a children’s play area, and cooking classes. In addition, visitors can book river cruises along the Thu Bon River or join guided tours to explore Hoi An’s most famous attractions.

Address: 1 Pham Hong Thai Street, Cam Chau Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 3,500,000 VND per room per night

2. Koi Resort & Spa Hoi An

Often described as a green oasis by the peaceful De Vong River, Koi Resort & Spa Hoi An offers a luxurious yet tranquil retreat that perfectly captures the spirit of Hoi An. The rooms are designed in an elegant Asian style, featuring warm brown and golden tones, with views overlooking the river, lush gardens, or the vibrant town.

The resort’s signature koi fish pond is a standout feature, along with unique experiences such as fishing and kayaking on the river, making it an ideal choice for travelers seeking relaxation combined with meaningful activities.

Address: Au Co Street, Cua Dai Beach, Cua Dai Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 18,400,000 VND per room per night

3. Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel

Laluna Hoi An Riverside Hotel is widely praised for its stunning riverside location along the Hoai River, complete with a scenic walking path that embraces the waterway. Guests can admire the magical beauty of Hoi An at sunrise or sunset from spacious balconies overlooking the river.

One of Laluna’s greatest advantages is its location only a five-minute walk from the heart of the Ancient Town making it perfect for travelers who want easy access to major attractions while still enjoying a peaceful stay.

Address: 12 Nguyen Du Street, Cam Pho Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 16,500,000 VND per room per night

4. Heron House Hoi An

Heron House Hoi An is a charming accommodation that transports guests back to the peaceful atmosphere of old Hoi An. Featuring traditional architecture with red-tiled roofs, wooden furniture, patterned tiles, bamboo blinds, and rustic details, the property offers a nostalgic and serene experience.

The hotel is surrounded by vast rice fields, creating a refreshing countryside ambiance. Guests can wake up to golden sunlight over the fields and explore nearby rural areas by bicycle, gaining an authentic glimpse into local life.

Address: An My, Cam Chau Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 1,200,000 VND per room per night

5. An Bang Garden Homestay

An Bang Garden Homestay is an excellent option for families or groups of friends. This cozy accommodation boasts a prime location, with one side facing the sea and the other opening into a quiet residential area.

After enjoying breakfast and coffee, guests can borrow bicycles to explore nearby attractions such as Phuc Kien Assembly Hall, Cua Dai Beach, and An Bang Beach. Its relaxed atmosphere and affordable price make it a favorite among budget-conscious travelers.

Address: Nguyen Phan Vinh Street, An Bang Ward, Hoi An
Reference Price: From 730,000 VND per room per night

Final Thoughts

Whether you prefer staying near the Ancient Town or close to the beach, choosing a budget-friendly stay or indulging in luxury, we hope this curated list helps you find the perfect accommodation for your Hoi An journey. These hotels offer excellent value for money, allowing you to fully enjoy the beauty, culture, and charm of Hoi An without exceeding your budget.
